lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines. Inter-line spacing is narrowest at the shoulder region and progressively widens toward the posterior haunches.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation observed at the dorsal termination of the 11th vertical line (counting from anterior to posterior).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 2, 3, and 12 show early termination before reaching the ventral midline. Line 12 exists as an abbreviated segment in the upper-mid torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5 distinct white spots is located on the lower flank and upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior flank align to form a semi-connected horizontal geometric pattern roughly parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white spot on the lower cheek; distinct white chevron-like band traversing the base of the neck and upper chest transition.
